CustomField.description: The total of the quick quote line item excluding VAT. Includes Performance Fee, Artist and Technical Travel, Technical Fee (If Technical Fee is Included in Quote)
CustomField.formula: Artist_Fee_Definition__r.Price__c + Travel_Fee_Artist__c + IF( Quote__r.Include_Extras__c, Total_Artist_Extras__c + Total_Technical_Extras__c,0) + IF(Quote__r.Include_Technical_fee__c, IF( Artist__r.Travels_Alone__c, Travel_Fee_Technical__c ,0),0) + IF(Quote__r.Include_Technical_fee__c, IF(ISPICKVAL(Quote__r.Amount_of_People__c,'1 - 500'), Artist_Fee_Definition__r.Technical_1_500_people__c, Artist_Fee_Definition__r.Technical_501_1000_people__c ),0)
CustomField.label: Total Excl VAT
